title: Indonesia Asset, Licence, PSC & Digital Infrastructure Intelligence

methodology.scope: Selected evidence-led asset/operator dossiers, not the country's complete permits, SKK Migas KKKS, smelters or data center asset register.
distinctions: Oil-and-gas PSC has an operator/KKKS, participating interests, contract duration and asset-level lifting, not an IUP.
Mining IUP or IUPK grants mining rights; production in a company report can include multiple concessions, and is never assigned to one mine without asset-level data.
Cloud service regions, data-center campus IT power, cabinets and announced budgets are not interchangeable production measurements.
MoU, conditional finance, announced campus, physical construction, commissioned capacity and realized capital are separate milestones.
Investor nationality describes headquarters or named corporate affiliation, not the natural-person beneficial owner.
Blank or unknown fields mean not independently documented, NOT zero.
Company cumulative vehicle production is not current-year sales, and plant total nameplate vehicles/year is not BEV-only output.
Mandated national biodiesel volume is a government allocation, not realized deliveries by a named biodiesel manufacturer.
Green Book loans are planned financing access, not disbursed company CAPEX; upstream geothermal resource permits differ from electric power PPAs.
Nuclear is classified as 'New Energy', not renewable energy; site-evaluation approval is not a siting, construction or operating licence.
Pumped storage is electricity storage (grid consumption while pumping), not additional net renewable energy production.
RUPTL 2025–2034 incremental technology plans, project design MW and operational power are different time/status measures.
Hydro MW and solar PV MWp are different ratings, and historical contract tariffs should not be presented as current spot power prices.

ruplt_2025_2034.explanation: RUPTL planned additional capacities by technology. These are not current installed capacity or signed contracts. Solar PV MW, floating solar MWp, pumped storage MW and nuclear MWe are not directly additive as homogeneous generation.
